scope: 39 audited mechanisms and shared consumers; no PRD deployment
lockOrder: Plan then operation/order; task then assessment then preferences/payment/delivery; multiple rows in stable ID order. Catalogue writers prepare outside transactions; maintenance product acquisition uses NOWAIT to break the epoch/product writer cycle.
timingPolicy: Report acquisition latency and client-observed transaction duration separately. A lease lifetime is not a PostgreSQL row-lock hold time.

mechanisms.invariant: Serializes operation admission, revision publication and checkout against a single plan.
mechanisms.acquisition: Explicit mutation transaction or conditional write; ordinary reads never acquire this lock.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Revalidate ownership, revision and affected row identities; apply necessary writes only. Prepare, calculate, serialize, render and perform external effects outside the protected phase.
mechanisms.release: Acquisition to outer transaction commit/rollback; matching runs outside this transaction. No dedicated lock-hold TTL.

mechanisms.invariant: Claims/renews operation ownership, reserves attempts, saves checkpoints, expires/cancels work and records terminal publication.
mechanisms.acquisition: Explicit mutation transaction or conditional write; ordinary reads never acquire this lock.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Revalidate ownership, revision and affected row identities; apply necessary writes only. Prepare, calculate, serialize, render and perform external effects outside the protected phase.
mechanisms.release: Each UPDATE locks its row until its transaction ends; the 60-second ownership lease is separate.

mechanisms.invariant: Protects one result per revision, one response per idempotency key, one active task reservation and one active checkout per plan/revision.
mechanisms.acquisition: Explicit mutation transaction or conditional write; ordinary reads never acquire this lock.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Revalidate ownership, revision and affected row identities; apply necessary writes only. Prepare, calculate, serialize, render and perform external effects outside the protected phase.
mechanisms.release: Writes and concurrent unique-key conflicts resolve at transaction commit/rollback; permanent records are not permanently held locks.

mechanisms.invariant: Finds an existing frozen order while producing plan status/details and checking compatibility.
mechanisms.acquisition: Explicit mutation transaction or conditional write; ordinary reads never acquire this lock.
mechanisms.permittedWork: No production acquisition. Remove redundant serialization; retain request cancellation, deadlines and database integrity.
mechanisms.release: From finding the order until the surrounding presentation transaction ends, including subsequent snapshot loading and catalogue checking.

mechanisms.resource: Order mutation / checkout reuse — FOR UPDATE
mechanisms.invariant: Serializes payment transitions, fulfilment events and reuse of an open checkout.
mechanisms.acquisition: Explicit mutation transaction or conditional write; ordinary reads never acquire this lock.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Revalidate ownership, revision and affected row identities; apply necessary writes only. Prepare, calculate, serialize, render and perform external effects outside the protected phase.
mechanisms.release: Mutation transaction; order reads inside outbox handling hold it through that event transaction.

mechanisms.invariant: Selection and creation of new checkout validate current commercial facts atomically. Matching publication retains its immutable snapshot and ordinary reads take no epoch lock.
mechanisms.acquisition: Explicit mutation transaction or conditional write; ordinary reads never acquire this lock.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Revalidate ownership, revision and affected row identities; apply necessary writes only. Prepare, calculate, serialize, render and perform external effects outside the protected phase.
mechanisms.release: Acquisition to transaction end. In result completion this includes subsequent result-item writes.

mechanisms.resource: Global catalogue epoch writer — UPDATE / FOR UPDATE

mechanisms.acquisition: Explicit mutation transaction or conditional write; ordinary reads never acquire this lock.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Revalidate ownership, revision and affected row identities; apply necessary writes only. Prepare, calculate, serialize, render and perform external effects outside the protected phase.
mechanisms.release: From first epoch update/lock to end of the writer transaction; a whole correction batch can retain it.

mechanisms.resource: Reviewed product corrections — FOR UPDATE NOWAIT

mechanisms.acquisition: Explicit mutation transaction or conditional write; ordinary reads never acquire this lock.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Revalidate ownership, revision and affected row identities; apply necessary writes only. Prepare, calculate, serialize, render and perform external effects outside the protected phase.
mechanisms.release: Until the correction transaction ends, potentially across the whole manifest; acquisition fails immediately if its row is locked.

mechanisms.permittedWork: Revalidate ownership, revision and affected row identities; apply necessary writes only. Prepare, calculate, serialize, render and perform external effects outside the protected phase.

mechanisms.permittedWork: Revalidate ownership, revision and affected row identities; apply necessary writes only. Prepare, calculate, serialize, render and perform external effects outside the protected phase.

mechanisms.permittedWork: Revalidate ownership, revision and affected row identities; apply necessary writes only. Prepare, calculate, serialize, render and perform external effects outside the protected phase.

mechanisms.invariant: Prevents two schedulers dispatching the same due cron entry.

mechanisms.permittedWork: Revalidate ownership, revision and affected row identities; apply necessary writes only. Prepare, calculate, serialize, render and perform external effects outside the protected phase.
mechanisms.release: Claim/update statement transaction.

mechanisms.resource: PostgreSQL implicit relation / transaction / foreign-key locks
mechanisms.invariant: Ordinary SELECTs use relation AccessShare; row-locking reads and writes also take relation locks. FK checks can lock referenced keys; transaction-ID waits represent conflicting uncommitted writes.
mechanisms.acquisition: Explicit mutation transaction or conditional write; ordinary reads never acquire this lock.
mechanisms.permittedWork: PostgreSQL unique, foreign-key and relation integrity. Application code must not attempt to bypass engine integrity locking.
mechanisms.release: Typically transaction lifetime. Internal buffer/WAL/latch waits are shorter engine critical sections, not app-owned leases; no per-site duration evidence was captured.

mechanisms.acquisition: Limits simultaneously admitted observed MCP requests per process.
mechanisms.permittedWork: No production acquisition. Remove redundant serialization; retain request cancellation, deadlines and database integrity.

mechanisms.invariant: Second request-level admission counter, acquired after admission permit.
mechanisms.acquisition: Second request-level admission counter, acquired after admission permit.
mechanisms.permittedWork: No production acquisition. Remove redundant serialization; retain request cancellation, deadlines and database integrity.
mechanisms.release: Same request lifetime; while waiting, the earlier admission permit remains occupied.

mechanisms.invariant: Third request-level counter, acquired after admission and worker permits.
mechanisms.acquisition: Third request-level counter, acquired after admission and worker permits.
mechanisms.permittedWork: No production acquisition. Remove redundant serialization; retain request cancellation, deadlines and database integrity.
mechanisms.release: Same request lifetime; earlier permits stay occupied while waiting.

mechanisms.invariant: Limits catalogue-load/pin sections and execute database sections.
mechanisms.acquisition: Limits catalogue-load/pin sections and execute database sections.
mechanisms.permittedWork: No production acquisition. Remove redundant serialization; retain request cancellation, deadlines and database integrity.
mechanisms.release: Held around the entire load/pin or execute write section; released in finally. Exhaustion throws immediately rather than waiting.

mechanisms.acquisition: Bounds worker-thread search concurrency per process.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Only the bounded productive work or immutable coalescing described by this mechanism; never serialize unrelated ordinary reads.
mechanisms.release: Each chunk has a 15-second deadline starting at enqueue, including queue wait. A cancelled running slot remains occupied until thread exit.

mechanisms.resource: Web product CPU pool — 2 slots / 8 queued jobs
mechanisms.invariant: Runs questionnaire product matching off the external worker event loop.
mechanisms.acquisition: Runs questionnaire product matching off the external worker event loop.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Only the bounded productive work or immutable coalescing described by this mechanism; never serialize unrelated ordinary reads.
mechanisms.release: Default 60-second job timeout including queueing. Slot released on result or worker exit.

mechanisms.resource: External product-worker slot and task lease
mechanisms.invariant: Only the durable executor owns matching tasks; productive dispatch follows the shared two-slot CPU budget, with no watching task occupying another slot.
mechanisms.acquisition: One product-profile slot per UAT replica claims generate_product_recommendations / match_agentic_plan and related product tasks.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Only the bounded productive work or immutable coalescing described by this mechanism; never serialize unrelated ordinary reads.
mechanisms.release: Effective task lease 180 seconds from registration, normally renewed every 36 seconds. Slot lasts until execute plus complete/fail handling finishes. Finalization temporarily extends lease by 300 seconds.

mechanisms.invariant: Stops two processes publishing the same matching operation.
mechanisms.acquisition: Stops two processes publishing the same matching operation.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Only the bounded productive work or immutable coalescing described by this mechanism; never serialize unrelated ordinary reads.
mechanisms.release: 60-second operation ownership lease; each renewal/reservation/checkpoint SQL write releases its row lock at commit. Overall operation deadline stays 175 seconds.

mechanisms.invariant: Prevents a different revision being admitted while a plan operation is queued/running/retryable.
mechanisms.acquisition: Prevents a different revision being admitted while a plan operation is queued/running/retryable.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Only the bounded productive work or immutable coalescing described by this mechanism; never serialize unrelated ordinary reads.
mechanisms.release: Until terminal state, cancellation, or expiry persistence. The intended overall deadline is 175 seconds; expiry is enforced when work/polls run.

mechanisms.invariant: Coalesces same-key requests, same plan/revision/request matching and same operation execution in one process.
mechanisms.acquisition: Coalesces same-key requests, same plan/revision/request matching and same operation execution in one process.
mechanisms.permittedWork: No production acquisition. Remove redundant serialization; retain request cancellation, deadlines and database integrity.
mechanisms.release: Until corresponding Promise settles or cleanup occurs; HTTP handoff at up to 3 seconds does not release admitted matching ownership.

mechanisms.invariant: Joins concurrent country snapshot loads and pin preparation instead of loading the catalogue separately each time.
mechanisms.acquisition: Joins concurrent country snapshot loads and pin preparation instead of loading the catalogue separately each time.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Only the bounded productive work or immutable coalescing described by this mechanism; never serialize unrelated ordinary reads.
mechanisms.release: Until the shared load settles. No dedicated mutex TTL; database/request deadlines constrain its work. Cache freshness TTL is not lock lifetime.

mechanisms.invariant: Coalesces a reference load for one catalogue epoch.
mechanisms.acquisition: Coalesces a reference load for one catalogue epoch.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Only the bounded productive work or immutable coalescing described by this mechanism; never serialize unrelated ordinary reads.
mechanisms.release: Until SELECT/parse/fingerprint succeeds or fails. The 10-minute cache TTL is not a held lock.

mechanisms.invariant: Coalesces loading of served markets.

mechanisms.release: Until one database load completes; 60-second cache TTL is not a lock duration.

mechanisms.acquisition: Limits database concurrency: each configured application/worker client pool max 30; the managed UAT transaction pool has 30 server slots in total.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Only the bounded productive work or immutable coalescing described by this mechanism; never serialize unrelated ordinary reads.

mechanisms.invariant: Waits for queued work through local signals, PostgreSQL notification and HTTP worker wake.
mechanisms.acquisition: Waits for queued work through local signals, PostgreSQL notification and HTTP worker wake.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Only the bounded productive work or immutable coalescing described by this mechanism; never serialize unrelated ordinary reads.
mechanisms.release: Configured default poll wait 24 seconds; HTTP wake timeout 1.5 seconds. No database row lock is held while sleeping.

mechanisms.invariant: Coalesces worker-schema inspection, skips overlapping maintenance ticks and suppresses competing background warmups.
mechanisms.acquisition: Coalesces worker-schema inspection, skips overlapping maintenance ticks and suppresses competing background warmups.
mechanisms.permittedWork: Only the bounded productive work or immutable coalescing described by this mechanism; never serialize unrelated ordinary reads.
mechanisms.release: Until each Promise/job settles. Maintenance first tick after 60 seconds, then every 15 seconds; schema success cached for process lifetime.

mechanisms.invariant: Protects public MCP capacity, including plan polling.
mechanisms.acquisition: Protects public MCP capacity, including plan polling.

sites.statement: ` with candidate as ( select tasks.id from public.tasks join public.organisations task_organisations on task_organisations.id = tasks.organisation_id where tasks.status = 'queued' and coalesce(tasks.actor_type, 'system') <> 'human' and tasks.scheduled_for <= now() and tasks.attempts < tasks.max_attempts and not (tasks.id = any(${uuidArray(sql, input.skipTaskIds)}::uuid[])) and ( coalesce(cardinality(tasks.required_capabilities), 0) = 0 or tasks.required_capabilities <@ ${textArray(sql, input.reserveCapabilities)}::text[] ) and ( ${input.mustRequireCapability}::text is null or ${input.mustRequireCapability} = any(tasks.required_capabilities) ) and ( ${input.taskTypes.length < 1} or tasks.task_type = any(${textArray(sql, input.taskTypes)}::text[]) ) and ( ( ${input.accessScope.role}::text = 'platform_agent' and task_organisations.organisation_type = 'platform' ) or ( ${input.accessScope.role}::text = 'retail_agent' and task_organisations.organisation_type = 'tenant' and tasks.organisation_id = ${input.accessScope.organisationId}::uuid ) ) order by coalesce(tasks.priority_score, tasks.business_value) desc, tasks.scheduled_for asc, tasks.created_at asc limit 1 for update of tasks skip locked ) update public.tasks set status = 'reserved', reserved_by_agent_id = ${input.accessScope.agentId}::uuid, lease_until = now() + make_interval(secs => ${input.leaseSeconds}), updated_at = now() from candidate where public.tasks.id = candidate.id and public.tasks.status = 'queued' returning public.tasks.* `
sites.justification: Ensures one worker reserves each eligible task.
